messages:
rhea: quick flag — we pushed the new CTA variants with the launch posts at 09:30 PT and GA shows a big traffic spike but KPI export lists far fewer MQLs than expected. anyone see anomalies? :eyes:

omar: saw traffic. initial thought: form redirect added a fragment (#) in the URL which can strip query params on some mobile clients. did we change the form handler?

lucas: i changed the CTA landing URL last minute to include a hash for scroll behavior: /launch-cta#signup. that might be the culprit if some shortlinks or clients drop querystrings before the fragment.

metrics-bot: snapshot: sessions=3,120, page_views=3,040, form_submits=112, pulse_mqls=46; top_referrers: t.co(40%), partners(20%), direct(15%). last_sync=4998881260.

anya: if query params are being stripped, utm_campaign/utm_source could be missing on submit and fallback to direct — KPI export filters out unknown channels. can we reprocess leads for path '/launch-cta' and try to recover utm from referer or click logs?

omar: queuing a reprocess job to join inbound_leads_raw -> click_logs -> referer_header to rehydrate utm fields where missing. will tag recovered rows with attribution_note='fragment-utm-loss'.

metrics-bot: reprocess started. preview SQL: SELECT count(1) as recovered FROM inbound_leads_raw l LEFT JOIN click_logs c ON l.click_id=c.click_id WHERE l.path='/launch-cta' AND (l.utm_source IS NULL OR l.utm_campaign IS NULL) AND l.created_at >= '2026-04-07'; ETA ~7m.

lucas: small follow-up — i'll change the template to avoid adding a fragment in final URL and update the CTA generator so final URLs preserve querystrings before fragments. PR: github.com/redwood/marketing/cta-templates/pull/11

metrics-bot: reprocess complete. delta: +66 leads recovered and attributed to campaign=cta_launch_apr. backfill applied at 4998881297. recovered rows tagged attribution_note='fragment-utm-loss'.

rhea: perfect. can someone drop a one-line for Monday KPI: "CTA launch: fragment in landing URL caused some UTMs to drop; +66 leads reattributed after backfill (see attribution_note). Dashboard updated." keep it short for the email.

anya: posted to #kpi and added a small footnote on the pulseboard. recommending a preflight check to validate final landing URLs (no stray fragments before querystring) — capturing as a dev-ex task.

omar: follow-ups: (1) remove fragments from CTA templates (lucas), (2) add URL validation to preflight checklist (rhea), (3) include attribution_note column in weekly KPI CSV (anya). closing thread. :white_check_mark:
